title: Signal schild.signal/0.3 (client -> lab)
description: Positive list (decision E4). Only these fields exist; unknown fields are rejected. Never a visitor IP (not truncated, hashed or as pseudonym), never a site identifier, URL, header, cookie or body. Framing fields (schema, id, kind) carry no data about visitor or site. DSSE payloadType application/vnd.schild.signal.v0+json.

id.description: Random per signal, used only for dedupe and ACK. Retries and copies to other labs reuse it; it is never derived from site, visitor or key.

kind.description: Client signals are always tips, never evidence (G2).

action_sig.description: Action signature: what was attempted, e.g. login-burst/wp-admin or sqli/rest-api. At most 64 characters. No host, no query, no values, nothing address-like.

request_sig.description: sha256 over the canonical request shape (signal.md): method, path template, sorted parameter names, content type, matched rule ids. No host, no values, no IP.

waf_rules.description: Matched rule ids, strictly ascending (canonical order, same as in request_sig); verifiers reject other orders with code schema.

protected.description: Sender is on the signed protection list (G6).

family.description: Browser or tool family, lower case, no dots (no version strings, host names or addresses).

ja4.description: Optional TLS client fingerprint (JA4). Prototype and alpha only; coarse or absent from v1.
